source: Original Unity UI.Image.GenerateSprite + original Sprite runtime getters

evidence.formula: spritePivot = Sprite.pivot / Sprite.rect.size; drawSize = GetPixelAdjustedRect.size, preserving aspect when enabled; drawOffset = (RectTransform.pivot - spritePivot) * drawSize; localVertex = Sprite.vertices / Sprite.bounds.size * drawSize - drawOffset; indices = Sprite.triangles.
